ticket.title: Add CI workflow for lint, type, and smoke tests

objective: Add hard CI gates and workflow compliance checks for CycleSmith self-hosting.

validation: uv run cyclesmith memory -- --memory reports/dev_loop/memory_snapshot.json validate
